acceptanceCriteria: A fresh ticket create or refine whose effects hold an exact PATH key naming a directory in HEAD's tree adds one EXACT_KEY_NAMES_DIRECTORY warning, with a test.
Replays, file keys and keys ending in / add none, and the stored ticket is unchanged.
body: Follow-up to V1-1118 (PR beamfall/corvint#747, proposed CAL-V0-211), which adds the warning to set-effects and claim only; create/refine effects were a non-goal. A ticket created or refined with a touchPaths or PATH resource key without a trailing / that names a directory still gets no warning until set-effects or claim. Proposal: the same non-refusing warning on a fresh create/refine transaction, sharing internal/tasks/store/directory_keys.go. Depends on CAL-V0-211 acceptance.
